QuestInfo.name: Aldin Grows Brave
QuestInfo.0: Aldin's love for Sirin was one-sided. He said he was happy just watching her, but Alpha and Beta wanted to help him out.
QuestInfo.1: Aldin cannot get over his shyness to confess his love for Sirin. He thinks he is not good looking enough for her. Maybe you can help. Go get #r#t4033906##k so that it can be given to Sirin as a gift.
QuestInfo.2: Aldin thinks  #r#t4033906##k can be used as a decoration by Sirin and he hopes that that she will accpet his love. You hope that she does but you leave it all to them now since you have done everything you can.
